title: Draft a reply
summary: Draft a reply to a message covering given points, in a chosen tone.

sections.use: Draft a reply to a message, email or ticket that covers the points you give, in a neutral, warm or firm tone.
sections.exclusions: It does not send anything and adds no commitments, facts or dates of its own.
sections.limitations: Needs a model context of at least 16,384 tokens (prompt, input, one repair and 2,048 output tokens). Results are model output: review them. Message up to 8,000 characters; points up to 4,000; reply up to 6,000.
sections.missing_data: With no points, the reply is a brief acknowledgement.
sections.effects: Sends its inputs to the model of its role (fast by default) and returns the result for review. With unrestricted ports and unrestricted data, that model may be remote; the Add dialog shows the destination. Label inputs Local only to keep them on this machine.
sections.failures: If the reply does not meet the output contract after two repairs, the step fails with located issues. A context or token limit is reported as such; shorten the input or use a larger context.
